```{r}
setwd("E:/Splicata/16S-RNA-DNA/3Microbioma")
codes <- read.table("metadata.txt", header = TRUE)
micro <- read.table("Abundance_matrix_nozero.txt", sep="\t", header=T)
micro <- micro[,c(1:15)]

```

```{r}
#shannon
shan<-as.data.frame(diversity(micro,index="shannon",MARGIN = 2))
shan <- cbind(shan,codes)
colnames(shan)[1]<- c("Shannon")

shanBAR <- shan[which(shan$Pop=="BAR"),]
sd(shanBAR$Shannon)

shanBLA <- shan[which(shan$Pop=="BLA"),]
sd(shanBLA$Shannon)

shanVIL <- shan[which(shan$Pop=="VIL"),]
sd(shanVIL$Shannon)

shanAA <- shan[which(shan$Chr2=="AA"),]
sd(shanAA$Shannon)
shanAB <- shan[which(shan$Chr2=="AB"),]
sd(shanAB$Shannon)

pdf("Shan_pop.pdf", width= 4, height=2.25)
ggplot(shan, aes(y=Shannon,x=Pop, fill=Pop)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(alpha=0.5), outlier.size = 0, lwd=0.5) +
  geom_jitter(size=3, position=position_jitterdodge(0.5), pch=4, stroke=1)+
  xlab(NULL) + 
  ylab("") +
     scale_fill_manual( values = c("indianred","steelblue","yellow3")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position="none", 
         panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
         panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
         panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"))
dev.off()

pdf("Shan_chr2_allsamples.pdf", width= 4, height=2.25)
```

```{r}
#Richness
rich<-rarefy(micro,min(colSums(micro)),MARGIN = 2)
rich <- as.data.frame(rich)
rich <- cbind(rich,codes)
colnames(rich)[1] <- c("Richness")


richBAR <- rich[which(rich$Pop=="BAR"),]
median(richBAR$Richness)

richBLA <- rich[which(rich$Pop=="BLA"),]
median(richBLA$Richness)

richVIL <- rich[which(rich$Pop=="VIL"),]
median(richVIL$Richness)

rich2AA <- rich[which(rich$Chr2=="AA"),]
sd(rich2AA$Richness)
rich2AB <- rich[which(rich$Chr2=="AB"),]
sd(rich2AB$Richness)

rich16AA <- rich[which(rich$Chr16=="AA"),]
sd(rich16AA$Richness)
rich16AB <- rich[which(rich$Chr16=="AB"),]
sd(rich16AB$Richness)


pdf("Rich_pop.pdf", width= 2.5, height=5)
ggplot(rich, aes(y=Richness,x=Pop, fill=Pop)) + 
  geom_boxplot(aes(alpha=0.5), outlier.size = 0, lwd=0.5) +
  geom_jitter(size=3, position=position_jitterdodge(0.5), pch=4, stroke=1)+

     scale_fill_manual( values = c("indianred","steelblue","yellow3")) +

         panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# GLM
library(lmtest)

#Shannon
GLM_Pop <-glm(rank(Shannon) ~ Pop, data = shan)
qqnorm(resid(GLM_Pop)) + qqline(resid(GLM_Pop))
hist(resid(GLM_Pop))
shapiro.test(residuals(GLM_Pop))
bptest(GLM_Pop)
Anova(GLM_Pop, test="F")
rsq(GLM_Pop,adj=TRUE,type=c('v','kl','sse','lr','n'))

GLM_chr2 <-glm(rank(Shannon) ~ Chr2, data = shan)
qqnorm(resid(GLM_chr2)) + qqline(resid(GLM_chr2))
hist(resid(GLM_chr2))
shapiro.test(residuals(GLM_chr2))
bptest(GLM_chr2)
Anova(GLM_chr2, test="F")
rsq(GLM_chr2,adj=TRUE,type=c('v','kl','sse','lr','n'))

GLM_chr4 <-glm(rank(Shannon) ~ Chr4, data = shan[c(-14),])
qqnorm(resid(GLM_chr4)) + qqline(resid(GLM_chr4))
hist(resid(GLM_chr4))
shapiro.test(residuals(GLM_chr4))
bptest(GLM_chr4)
Anova(GLM_chr4, test="F")
rsq(GLM_chr4,adj=TRUE,type=c('v','kl','sse','lr','n'))

GLM_chr11 <-glm(rank(Shannon) ~ Chr11, data = shan[-c(8,10),])
qqnorm(resid(GLM_chr11)) + qqline(resid(GLM_chr11))
hist(resid(GLM_chr11))
shapiro.test(residuals(GLM_chr11))
bptest(GLM_chr11)
Anova(GLM_chr11, test="F")
rsq(GLM_chr11,adj=TRUE,type=c('v','kl','sse','lr','n'))

GLM_chr16 <-glm(rank(Shannon) ~ Chr16, data = shan)
qqnorm(resid(GLM_chr16)) + qqline(resid(GLM_chr16))
hist(resid(GLM_chr16))
shapiro.test(residuals(GLM_chr16))
bptest(GLM_chr16)
Anova(GLM_chr16, test="F")
rsq(GLM_chr16,adj=TRUE,type=c('v','kl','sse','lr','n'))


GLM_Pop2 <- emmeans(GLM_Pop, ~ Pop)
contrast(GLM_Pop2, method="tukey", simple="each", combine = TRUE, adjust="none")

GLM_shan2 <- emmeans(GLM_chr2, ~ Chr2)
contrast(GLM_shan2, method="tukey", simple="each", combine = TRUE, adjust="none")
pdf("Shan_Inv2.pdf", height=4, width=5)
emmip(GLM_chr2, ~Chr2, CI=TRUE, dodge = 0.6) + theme(legend.position = "bottom") + scale_colour_manual(name = "Karyotype", breaks=c("AA", "AB"), values=c("#ecd6c0","#bf9780")) 
dev.off()

#Richness
GLM_Rich_pop <- glm(rank(Richness) ~ Pop, data = rich)
qqnorm(resid(GLM_Rich_pop)) + qqline(resid(GLM_Rich_pop))
hist(resid(GLM_Rich_pop))
shapiro.test((residuals(GLM_Rich_pop)))
bptest(GLM_Rich_pop)
Anova(GLM_Rich_pop, test="F")
rsq(GLM_Rich_pop,adj=TRUE,type=c('v','kl','sse','lr','n'))

GLM_Rich_chr2 <- glm(rank(Richness) ~ Chr2, data = rich)
qqnorm(resid(GLM_Rich_chr2)) + qqline(resid(GLM_Rich_chr2))
hist(resid(GLM_Rich_chr2))
shapiro.test((residuals(GLM_Rich_chr2)))
bptest(GLM_Rich_chr2)
Anova(GLM_Rich_chr2, test="F")
rsq(GLM_Rich_chr2,adj=TRUE,type=c('v','kl','sse','lr','n'))

GLM_Rich_chr4 <- glm(rank(Richness) ~ Chr4, data = rich[c(-14),])
qqnorm(resid(GLM_Rich_chr4)) + qqline(resid(GLM_Rich_chr4))
hist(resid(GLM_Rich_chr4))
shapiro.test((residuals(GLM_Rich_chr4)))
bptest(GLM_Rich_chr4)
Anova(GLM_Rich_chr4, test="F")
rsq(GLM_Rich_chr4,adj=TRUE,type=c('v','kl','sse','lr','n'))

GLM_Rich_chr11 <- glm(rank(Richness) ~ Chr11, data = rich[-c(8,10),])
qqnorm(resid(GLM_Rich_chr11)) + qqline(resid(GLM_Rich_chr11))
hist(resid(GLM_Rich_chr11))
shapiro.test((residuals(GLM_Rich_chr11)))
bptest(GLM_Rich_chr11)
Anova(GLM_Rich_chr11, test="F")
rsq(GLM_Rich_chr11,adj=TRUE,type=c('v','kl','sse','lr','n'))

GLM_Rich_chr16 <- glm(rank(Richness) ~ Chr16, data = rich)
qqnorm(resid(GLM_Rich_chr16)) + qqline(resid(GLM_Rich_chr16))
hist(resid(GLM_Rich_chr16))
shapiro.test((residuals(GLM_Rich_chr16)))
bptest(GLM_Rich_chr16)
Anova(GLM_Rich_chr16, test="F")
rsq(GLM_Rich_chr16,adj=TRUE,type=c('v','kl','sse','lr','n'))


GLM_pop <- emmeans(GLM_Rich_pop, ~ Pop)
contrast(GLM_pop, method="tukey", simple="each", combine = T, adjust="none")
pdf("Rich_Pop.pdf", height=4, width=5)
emmip(GLM_Rich_pop, ~Pop, CI=TRUE, dodge = 0.6) + theme(legend.position = "bottom") + scale_colour_manual(name = "Population", breaks=c("BAR", "BLA", "VIL"), values=c("#2E2E2E", "#E67E22","#0B00FB")) 
dev.off()

GLM_rich2 <- emmeans(GLM_Rich_chr2, ~ Chr2)
contrast(GLM_rich2, method="tukey", simple="each", combine = TRUE, adjust="none")
pdf("Rich_Inv2.pdf", height=4, width=5)
emmip(GLM_Rich_chr2, ~Chr2, CI=TRUE, dodge = 0.6) + theme(legend.position = "bottom") + scale_colour_manual(name = "Population", breaks=c("BAR", "BLA", "VIL"), values=c("#2E2E2E", "#E67E22","#0B00FB")) 
dev.off()

GLM_rich16 <- emmeans(GLM_Rich_chr16, ~ Chr16)
contrast(GLM_rich16, method="tukey", simple="each", combine = TRUE, adjust="none")
pdf("Rich_Inv16.pdf", height=4, width=5)
emmip(GLM_Rich_chr16, ~Chr16, CI=TRUE, dodge = 0.6) + theme(legend.position = "bottom") + scale_colour_manual(name = "Population", breaks=c("BAR", "BLA", "VIL"), values=c("#2E2E2E", "#E67E22","#0B00FB")) 
dev.off()
```
